name: infinite-tag
description: Founder-run installer that adds analytics (the Infinite first-party pixel, Google Analytics 4, PostHog, X/Twitter Pixel, Meta Pixel) to your web app — public keys only, idempotent, and reversible. --server-lane adds the lossless server lane: every HTML document request and every confirmed outcome, counted server-side, installed by your agent. By Infinite — https://infinite.fast
author: Infinite (https://infinite.fast)

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const msg='infinite-tag installed. Next: run npx infinite-tag install --workspace <workspace-id> from your website repo. Package install alone does not wire analytics.'; console.error(msg)"
